Package Domain.Model

Class AlgoritmeClustering

java.lang.Object
Domain.Model.AlgoritmeClustering
Direct Known Subclasses:
K_means, Kmedoids
public abstract class AlgoritmeClustering extends Object
Represents a clustering algorithm for survey responses (RespostaEnquesta). The algorithm can compute clusters based on a specified number of clusters (k) or determine the best k. The algorithm holds the original and changed responses to handle missing data imputation.
